defaultDescription: FrontX is an open-source kit for web applications built from a shell, screen microfrontends and a shared UI kit.
ogImageAlt: FrontX by Constructor Fabric: build complex web applications on a shared foundation. A shell, independent screen microfrontends and a shared UI kit.

llmsSections.heading: Build and run this site
items: Install: `npm ci`, then `npm run setup` (composes the templates into `site/` and installs the site).
Develop: `npm run dev` serves the site at http://localhost:5173/.
Build: `SITE_ORIGIN=https://<domain> npm run build` writes the static site to `site/dist/`.

Run the site: `npm start` installs and builds it when `site/dist/` is missing or out of date, then serves `site/dist/` on `$PORT` (default 8080), as a Node host such as DigitalOcean App Platform or Virtuozzo Application Platform runs it; `Dockerfile` builds the same site into a Caddy image.
